rules.T_int: same letter first-zero estimator, first instance per day/action; no concatenation; undefined if zero variance
rules.busiest: largest train-window mean directed-link Stay load; EV-TE link order breaks ties
rules.capacity: phase-A daytime 06:00-21:45 peak Stay rule on retained train weekdays; compare with phase-A value
rules.days: phase-A manifest/cache eligibility unchanged; weekdays only
rules.forecast: one train-average weekday profile, 24 slots of the selected window; no actual future input to M0
rules.hybrid: M0 Switch-minus-Stay gap plus h*s_hat; stationary chooses Switch iff s_hat<0; exact ties Stay
rules.managed: top three ODs crossing that link, descending train-window mean volume, OD ID breaks ties; no filter requiring Switch to avoid it
rules.pilot: earliest train weekday and largest train-window total-demand weekday (earliest tie), distinct; N=2, keep K64/R_dec64/R_eval128
rules.reporting: all results exploratory training/pilot; no test card, outcome, SSH or commit
rules.resolution: retain dt=.05s trace every train day; independent dt=.005s first-instance rollout on earliest weekday for each regime; also subsample .01/.05s; resolved only if T_int>=10*dt and <=5% change at 2*dt; zero covariance remains UNDEFINED at every dt
rules.s_hat: pooled mean per-day N200 integral-cost-rate difference Switch-minus-Stay over 6h
rules.telemetry: full state at decision start versus 5/15min earlier; actual past TM, K=64 Stay posterior samples
rules.truth: real 15-min TM times independent OD two-state modulation, beta=.3, kappa=1/s; phase-A dt=.05s
rules.warmup: two hours before selected window, empty Stay queues and independent per-instance mode roots; same phase-A lookback construction
rules.window: maximize mean total demand across train weekdays and 24 slots; 73 within-day starts, 15-min grid, earliest exact tie
